A '''holotrace device''' could trace a [[Hologram/Legends|Holo]]-[[Holotransmitter/Legends|transmission]] back to source of the transmission. [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] used one such device to trace [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] when brought before his hologram, when the former accused him of murdering his mother.
